title: BubbleDailyRewards
description: A stunning daily rewards GUI plugin for Purpur/Paper servers!
body:
**Give your players a reason to come back every single day!** ✨

BubbleDailyRewards is a beautiful, lightweight daily rewards plugin that replaces bulky GUI plugins with a sleek, modern interface. Perfect for Purpur & Paper servers running Minecraft 1.21+!

---

## 🌟 Why Choose BubbleDailyRewards?

✅ **One Command, Zero Hassle** – Just `/daily` and your players are rewarded!  
✅ **Stunning MiniMessage Support** – Full hex colors, gradients, bold/italic styling  
✅ **Smart Reset System** – Auto-resets at midnight UTC (configurable timezone)  
✅ **Seamless Crate Integration** – Works with CrateReloaded, CrazyCrates & more  
✅ **Folia Ready** – Optimized for modern multi-threaded servers  
✅ **Lightweight & Fast** – No database required, simple YAML storage  

---

## 🎯 Features

🔹 **Customizable GUI** – Change titles, materials, lore with MiniMessage tags  
🔹 **Permission-Based** – Control who can claim with `bubblepanel.daily`  
🔹 **Countdown Timer** – Shows players exactly when they can claim again  
🔹 **Multiple Aliases** – `/daily`, `/dailyreward`, `/rewards`  
🔹 **PlaceholderAPI Support** – Integrate with your server's existing systems  

---

## 🚀 Quick Start

1. Download the latest `.jar` file
2. Drop it into your `plugins/` folder
3. Restart your server
4. Run `/daily` in-game!

The default config gives players a daily crate key – customize it to fit your server's economy!

---

## 🛠️ Configuration

The plugin creates `plugins/BubbleDailyRewards/config.yml` where you can:
- Change the GUI title with gradients & hex colors
- Customize item materials, names, and lore
- Set timezone and reset time
- Configure reward commands

Full configuration docs in the [GitHub README](https://github.com/Ethan0892/BubbleDailyRewards)!
